description: Per-run learning curves behind Figure 2 of the paper and the paired comparisons of the appendix: error at each observation count n (x = initial observations + rounds). Metric: nMSLE on the 256 evaluation inputs (ChemBench, NewtonBench), the benchmark's headline error (BoxingGym; Survival analysis: the secondary series), nMSE on six shifted designs (ForceBench). Values are unfloored.
